name: popscale-platform
description: Read public Popscale documentation and safely administer company-scoped interviews, learning content, and journeys through separate remote MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Popscale content, interviews, and journeys
interface.longDescription: Search the public, read-only Popscale Docs MCP or connect to the company-scoped Popscale Platform MCP to find, create, and granularly edit roleplays, coaching sessions, challenges, episodes, flashcards, and existing journeys; administer interview Studies; or build validated learning journeys. Active edits, generation, distribution, and publication retain dedicated scopes, revision checks, and explicit confirmation boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Search the public Popscale docs for how journeys work and cite the page status.
Find our pricing roleplay and help me add one follow-up question without changing anything else.
Show my interview Studies and help me edit one question safely.
